title: EPIC 52 — Client i18n (RU/EN) + About the Game
body: Lobby EN|RU language switcher with localStorage persistence (cubewars.locale; default saved → browser ru* → en). Player-facing UI strings localized via client dictionaries. Map picker shows Russian display names when locale is ru. New About page (/about.html) explains modes, maps, weapons, pets (dog Armor / cat HP / bird speed% / lion damage%), inventory/auction/trade, spawn protection, ESC, hotkeys, and economy pools with examples and images. Footer About link beside Changelog and Telegram. Process: player-facing mechanic changes must update About + Last updated + Changelog in the same delivery.

title: EPIC 47 — Map density, bots map picker, ESC menu, changelog, auth UX
body: Maps densified (~4× pickups + more cover). Play vs Bots honors the lobby-selected map. ESC opens an in-match pause menu (Resume, Exit to Lobby, Change map, Inventory, Auction). Lobby Changelog link. Send password / Resend code shows a new on-screen login code (not emailed). Login accepts dashed or digit-only codes.

title: EPIC 46 — Multi-map catalog, picker, expanded Base, capacity 8
body: Eight static maps in a shared catalog. Lobby map picker for Public and Bots. Base arena expanded ~4× area with building and car landmarks. Public matches hold up to 8 players. Server owns match mapId.

title: EPIC 45 — Dual lobby inventory and auction bind
body: Lobby Deathmatch / Bots inventory buttons bind the correct economy pool. Auction stays on the Deathmatch pool. Stale profile races after dual bind are filtered client-side.

title: EPIC 44 — Kill loot drop VFX
body: Server-listed kill loot kinds render as cosmetic flyouts. Client never invents drop types.

title: EPIC 43 — Inventory icons and tooltips
body: Inventory grid shows item icons with hover tooltips and clearer side-by-side layout.

title: EPIC 42 — Lobby Telegram link and inventory entry
body: Lobby footer links to the developers Telegram chat. Inventory is reachable from the lobby without joining a match.

title: EPIC 41 — Spawn protection blocks fire
body: While spawn-protected, players cannot fire. Protection cue stays server-driven from world_state deadlines.

title: EPIC 40 — Companion pet distance scale
body: Visible companion pets scale with distance for clearer depth in matches.

title: EPIC 39 — Visible companion pets
body: Equipped pets render beside players in-match with cosmetic color support.

title: EPIC 38 — Auction, trade, and ground items
body: Deathmatch auction house, P2P trade window, and ground drop/pickup flow.

title: EPIC 37 — Leaderboard excludes bots mode
body: Career leaderboard no longer counts kills from private bots matches.

title: EPIC 36 — Spawn protection
body: Brief spawn protection after respawn with a HUD cue driven by server deadlines.

title: EPIC 35 — Split Deathmatch / Sandbox economy
body: Deathmatch and Bots/Endless use separate gold and inventory pools so sandbox farming cannot feed ranked play.

title: EPIC 34 — Account email + code stub auth
body: Email registration with on-screen NNN-NNN login codes, bcrypt storage, session resume, and login rate limits.

title: EPIC 33 — Avatar color customization
body: Players can set body-part color palettes stored with their profile.

title: EPIC 32 — Bot kills grant no economy reward
body: Killing bots does not mint gold or kill-loot economy rewards.

title: EPIC 31 — Bot equipment loadouts
body: Bots spawn with randomized pet/amulet cosmetic loadouts.

title: EPIC 30 — Weapon pickup visual polish
body: Weapon pickups and viewmodel feedback polished for clearer combat readability.

title: EPIC 29 — Inventory grid
body: 8×8 inventory overlay replaces the older list-only pets panel (I / P).

title: EPIC 28 — Lobby emerald lore
body: Lobby presents emerald / economy lore copy alongside gold display.

title: EPIC 27 — Redis economy store
body: Economy profiles and career totals persist in Redis across server restarts.

title: EPIC 26 — Durable achievements and drops
body: Achievements and drop accounting persist with the durable economy store.
